children: According to ChainCatcher citing Empire, Solana co-founder Raj Gokal said on X that the crypto industry’s next major competition will be between a financial internet and a financial intranet. Gokal quoted an Empire post citing Jason Yanowitz, who described the contest between permissionless Solana and semi-permissioned chains Canton, Arc and Tempo as the crypto industry’s most notable competition.

title: Solana Co-Founder Raj Gokal: Crypto’s Next Battle Is Financial Internet vs. Financial Intranet
